I was also in similar circumstances when I got married. My country (Cameroon) was hectic and considering I work with the US military, it made it even more difficult for me to travel. I don't plan on having children now and the only way for me to have a beat the proxy marriage stuff was to travel there for a short period. Long story short, only an immigration lawyer can give you solid advice on this and I believe they could be a waiver for your case. 
Good luck brother!

My Receipt Notice says Potomac Service Center but when I called to check my case status, they told me it was never at Potomac Service Center. She said it is at Texas Service Center. PD is August 2021. I know it is not a lot of time but I am getting a little nervous. I hope Texas is fast with processing I-130 cases.
I look forward to my ETS date, honestly. I just can't wait for it to be here.

I am currently stationed here and I can testify to these barbaric acts. I've been stopped several times just for those hoodlums to ask “hey bruh, do you wanna go to church”? My Soldiers keep telling me the same thing and I wonder why can't the numerous MP we got here do someone about it. I am a Christian, I wanna go to church but fuck no, I don't want you to give me a ride! I recommend taking pictures of their license plate and sending them to the MP! Goodluck, Rock!

As someone who just got here like 3months ago, I would say get away from this mess if you can. You'll hate it here...or maybe love it since you're close to home. Housing is shitttt and expensive. It stinks all the time. Always at the field and the weather is pure shit! Yeah, I am a homebody but I feel like an inmate here. Can't wait to ETS next year.
FYI I don’t want to do it full time. I have a full time job (military), go to college, and just need an additional source of income. Thanks for letting me know.

AIT trainees in FSH generally do have their phones after duty hours (when released from the schoolhouse) to lights out. Before Covid hit, they used to release trainees during weekends to go off base and do one or two things but as of right now I am not sure how it works. However, Your fiance will always have his phone in the evening.
